items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: And this band leader he looked to battle music with our band, and Glen Gray and the Casaloma in Griffiths Stadium.

ctx.x: That ain’t no competition, we were out of the park, we weren’t even in it. We used to listen, Benny Powell and I used to listen to tapes from that band, boy we’d listen to those tapes and laugh, ‘cause the band was so sad it was funny, you know. And Duke was fired up. But we had a lot of spirit, but that was all. The band was just sad that’s all. That was funny. Another time I was really embarrassed. I was working with this dance hall band and I was, I guess 16 or 17 years old, something like that. And this band…
Glen Gray, he was a pretty popular group at the time. Right?
